name: Kostchtchie
tactics: Kostchtchie in Combat Even compared to other demon lords, Kostchtchie is an avatar of raw destruction. The former frost giant begins each battle in a howling berserker rage that grows in intensity with each injury he takes. The number of demon lords that have fallen to his maul is a testament to Kostchtchie’s overwhelming ferocity. Orcus and Demogorgon are said to avoid direct confrontation with the Prince of Wrath, at least for now. Kostchtchie’s rivals know that they will face a final reckoning some day, but they are content to allow him to crush lesser abyssal powers until then. Kostchtchie out of Combat Anyone unfortunate enough to encounter Kostchtchie must usually fight him, but the Prince of Wrath sometimes gives his victims a chance to speak before crushing them. Though Kostchtchie is physically powerful, he has the mind of a child, and he is prone to petulant outbursts and fits of rage. Unlike those of most children, Kostchtchie’s tantrums can leave whole cities in ruins. Kostchtchie loves flattery: Diplomacy and Bluff are excellent skills to use against his anger. Intimidate can be effective, but use a minimum DC 40 check to represent the overwhelming challenge of cowing the Prince of Wrath. When such an attempt succeeds, it wins Kostchtchie’s respect with its audacity. Kostchtchie has been known to spare creatures that amuse him. Acrobatics or History checks made to entertain the demon lord can calm his rage.

alignment.name: Chaotic Evil
alignment.description:
Chaotic evil creatures have a complete disregard for others. They kill, steal, and betray others to gain power. Their word is meaningless and their actions destructive. Their worldviews can be so warped that they destroy anything and anyone that doesn’t directly contribute to their interests.
	By the standards of good and lawful good people, chaotic evil is as abhorrent as evil, perhaps even more so. Chaotic evil monsters such as demons and orcs are at least as much of a threat to civilization and general well-being as evil monsters are. An evil creature and a chaotic evil creature are both opposed to good, but they don’t have much respect for each other either and rarely cooperate toward common goals.
	For the purpose of game effects, a chaotic evil creature is also considered evil.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Speed of Wrath
traits.details: Kostchtchie takes a turn on his initiative check result and on his initiative check result -10. He has a full set of actions on each of his turns, and his ability to take an immediate action refreshes on each turn.

powers.trigger: Kostchtchie takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage.

effect.description: Kostchtchie gains resist 30 to the triggering damage type until the end of the encounter or until he uses variable resistance again.
